summary.text: Sue Prentiss is a Democratic state senator from West Lebanon, New Hampshire, who has represented District 5 since December 2020 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia, which lists her as Suzanne Prentiss, describes her profession as paramedic.

paragraphs.text: Prentiss lives in West Lebanon, New Hampshire. She earned a bachelor's degree from Saint Michael's College and a graduate degree from the University of Phoenix.
Her career experience includes working as a paramedic.
She assumed office in the State Senate on December 2, 2020, and in the 2025-2026 session serves on the Senate Education, Health and Human Services, and Senate Transportation committees.
